# Kreathief — AI Creative Director & Vector Studio

> Kreathief is a browser-first professional design suite combining multi-agent generative intelligence with precision vector craftsmanship, 3D mockups, and responsive artboards.

## Core Capabilities
- [AI Magic Object Eraser](https://kreathief.com/tools/magic-eraser): Browser-based context-aware generative fill and inpainting using local WebAssembly LaMa and cloud models.
- [AI Background Remover](https://kreathief.com/tools/background-remover): Sub-pixel precision foreground isolation for portraits, products, and complex edges.
- [Image to SVG Vectorizer](https://kreathief.com/tools/vectorizer): Automatic raster bitmap tracing into clean Bezier paths with node simplification and color clustering.
- [3D Mockup Generator](https://kreathief.com/tools/mockup-generator): Realistic apparel, packaging, and digital device stagers with fabric displacement mapping.
- [Smart Format Auto-Resize](https://kreathief.com/tools/smart-resize): Constraint-aware responsive canvas reflow adapting 1 design across 1:1, 9:16, 16:9, and 4:5 social formats.
- [60+ Aesthetic Design Movements](https://kreathief.com/tools/design-styles): Curated art direction presets (Bauhaus, Memphis, Cyberpunk, Swiss International, Brutalism).
- [Free Creative Tools Directory](https://kreathief.com/tools): Full directory of 9 verified browser-based creative tools.
- [Node Canvas Workspace](https://kreathief.com/canvas): Infinite design canvas with vector tools, layer management, and multiplayer editing.

## Documentation & Legal
- [Official Website](https://kreathief.com/): Kreathief homepage and product overview.
- [Creative Blog & Tutorials](https://kreathief.com/blog): In-depth design guides, typography pairings, and vector tutorials.
- [Privacy Policy](https://kreathief.com/privacy): Data protection, local WebAssembly sandbox execution, and zero data selling guarantee.
- [Terms of Service](https://kreathief.com/terms): Terms and conditions for individual and enterprise creators.
- [Security Standards](https://kreathief.com/security): Security architecture, CSP headers, and content isolation standards.

## Architecture & Privacy
- Zero data selling: user designs and local models run directly inside modern WebAssembly/WebGL browser sandboxes.
- Multi-format export: Crisp SVG code, multi-page vector PDF, layered Photoshop PSD, high-res PNG/WebP, and MP4 video.
